Enjoy the benefits of long-term living with the flexibility to come and go as you please. Whether you're escaping the cold northern winters or spending a few months exploring Central Texas, our monthly and seasonal sites offer the perfect solution. You'll enjoy stable rates, all amenities, and full access to our 55+ community. Perfect for flexible extended stays.
